target: Generated baseline base-color textures used by the Unity 4K benchmark

analysis.colorSpace: Decode source sRGB bytes to linear relative luminance before statistics.
analysis.directionalRamp: Fit a least-squares luminance plane over an 8x8 block-mean grid. Normalize the estimated opposite-side luminance difference (2 * gradient magnitude) by mean linear luminance.
analysis.centerEdgeContrast: Compare broad centre blocks (normalized radius <= 0.55) against outer blocks (radius >= 0.90), normalized by mean linear luminance.
analysis.tileSeam: Compute linear-luminance RMSE between left/right and top/bottom source edges, normalized by mean luminance.

physicalIntent.baseColor: Contains material pigmentation, aggregate/soil/vegetation color variation and other illumination-independent surface information only.
physicalIntent.specularAndFresnel: Angular highlights must arise from material BRDF/Fresnel response and scene lighting, never from a bright lobe painted into albedo.
physicalIntent.weathering: Directional dirt, splash, runoff, rust or UV change must remain in the separate cause-based contextual weathering system. This baseline check must not be weakened to accommodate unexplained directional shading.
physicalIntent.tileability: Baseline generated textures must not create a broad brightness seam whose repetition is obvious under grazing light.

failClosedRules: Missing GeneratedPBR baseline directory after final scene preparation is FAIL.
Fewer than six generated *_Albedo.png sources is FAIL.
Missing any required baseline albedo is FAIL.
Base albedo imported non-sRGB is FAIL.
Unable to decode source pixels is FAIL.
Directional ramp, centre-edge contrast or tile seam above its hard source threshold is FAIL.
limitations: This source statistic cannot prove final angular response or prove the absence of a locally painted highlight that does not produce the tested broad patterns.
Authored replacement art is not automatically cleared by this generated-baseline check; it must be inspected in the actual benchmark framing.
Passing this contract does not clear the critical baked-highlight defect. Sealed native 3840x2160 frontal/oblique/grazing evidence and 100% crops remain authoritative.
No source metric may award Visual Fidelity points.
